column1: tedious§Tedious work done well is what a good archive is made of.§好档案就是由**枯燥**而做得好的工作构成的。
temerity§It takes temerity to submit a paper with no results.§提交一篇没有结果的论文需要**蛮勇**。
temperamental§Temperamental differences explain more than method ever will.§**性情**上的差异比方法更能解释很多事。
temperance§The temperance movement changed the map of the town's pubs.§**禁酒运动**改变了这个镇的酒馆分布。
temporal§Temporal power and spiritual authority were held by one man.§**世俗权力**与宗教权威由一人掌握。
temporarily§Temporarily is the longest word in institutional English.§在机构用语里，“**临时**”是最长的一个词。
temporize§Temporizing is a strategy until the other side notices.§**拖延**是一种策略，直到对方察觉为止。
tempt§Do not tempt a reader with a title the book cannot keep.§不要用一个书本身兑现不了的标题去**诱惑**读者。
tenable§A tenable position is one you could argue against yourself.§**站得住脚**的立场，是你自己也能反驳的立场。
tenacious§A tenacious rumour outlived everyone it was about.§一个**顽固**的谣言比它所涉及的所有人活得都久。
tenacity§Tenacity without judgement is just a longer failure.§没有判断力的**坚韧**，只是更漫长的失败。
tenet§A central tenet of the method is that you write down failures.§这个方法的核心**原则**是把失败也记下来。
tension§Tension in the cable is measured twice a year.§缆索的**张力**每年测量两次。
tentative§A tentative conclusion clearly labeled is honest work.§明确标注为**暂定的**结论，是诚实的工作。
tenuous§His grasp of the dates was tenuous and his instinct was right.§他对日期的把握很**不牢靠**，直觉却是对的。
terminate§The line terminates at a station that no longer has a village.§这条线**终点站**所在的村庄已经不存在了。
terse§A terse email reads as rudeness in half the world.§在世界的一半地方，**简短**的邮件读起来像无礼。
testify§The building testifies to a confidence the accounts do not.§这栋建筑**见证**着账目里看不到的信心。
texture§The texture of the argument changes in the third chapter.§论证的**质地**在第三章发生了变化。
theorist§A theorist who has never built anything is easy to spot.§一个从未动手做过东西的**理论家**很容易辨认。
therapeutic§Cataloguing is therapeutic in a way nobody expects.§编目有一种谁也想不到的**疗愈**作用。
thoughtless§Thoughtless kindness can be as damaging as deliberate cruelty.§**不加思索**的好意可能和有意的残忍一样有害。
threaten§Clouds threatened all afternoon and delivered nothing.§乌云**威胁**了一下午，什么也没下。
thrive§A shop like that thrives only where rents are low.§那样的店铺只有在租金低的地方才**兴旺**。
thunderous§A thunderous silence followed the question.§问题之后是**雷鸣般**的沉默。
thwart§He sat on the thwart and rowed for six hours.§他坐在**横座板**上划了六小时。
timeless§Calling a design timeless usually dates it precisely.§把一个设计称作**永恒**，通常恰恰确定了它的年代。
timely§Timely is a matter of the reader's clock, not the writer's.§是否**及时**，取决于读者的钟，而不是作者的。
timeworn§A timeworn phrase can still be the exact one.§一个**陈旧的**说法仍可能是最准确的。
timid§Timid editing leaves the worst sentence in place.§**胆怯**的编辑会让最糟的句子留在原处。
timorous§A timorous first question makes the second one easier.§**怯生生**的第一个问题会让第二个变得容易。
titer§Antibody titers rose for three weeks and then plateaued.§抗体**滴度**上升了三周，随后趋于平稳。
toady§Nobody hires a toady on purpose; they arrive by promotion.§没人故意雇**马屁精**，他们是升上来的。
tolerable§Tolerable is the standard most public buildings actually meet.§“**还能忍受**”是大多数公共建筑实际达到的标准。
tolerate§A good system tolerates the mistakes people actually make.§好的系统能**容忍**人们真正会犯的错误。
tonic§Tonic water glows faintly under ultraviolet light.§**奎宁水**在紫外线下会微微发光。
totalitarian§Totalitarian regimes keep excellent records, which is how we know.§**极权**政权留下极好的记录，我们正因此得以知晓。
totality§Totality lasted two minutes and eleven seconds.§日**全食**的全食阶段持续了两分十一秒。
tout§Touts outside the theatre sold tickets that did not exist.§剧院外的**票贩子**卖着并不存在的票。
toxic§A toxic working culture is described in adjectives and measured in resignations.§**有毒**的职场文化用形容词描述，用辞职人数衡量。
toxicity§Toxicity depends on the dose, which is the whole of pharmacology.§**毒性**取决于剂量，这就是药理学的全部。
tractable§An intractable problem became tractable with better notation.§换一套更好的记号，一个棘手的问题就变得**好处理**了。
trait§The trait appears in one generation out of three.§这个**性状**每三代出现一次。
traitor§One man's traitor is another's founder, depending on the century.§一个人眼中的**叛徒**是另一个人眼中的开国者，取决于哪个世纪。
tranquil§A tranquil surface says nothing about the current beneath.§**平静的**水面说明不了下面的暗流。
tranquillise§Do not tranquillise a problem you could simply explain.§能解释清楚的问题就不要用**镇静剂**压下去。
transcribe§Transcribing an hour of tape takes about five hours.§**转写**一小时的录音大约要五小时。
transgression§A minor transgression, repeated, becomes a policy.§一次小小的**违规**反复发生，就成了惯例。
transient§A transient fault is the hardest kind to diagnose.§**偶发性**故障是最难诊断的一种。
transitory§Transitory fame and permanent debt often arrive together.§**短暂的**名声与永久的债务常常一起到来。
transmit§The disease transmits through water, not through air.§这种疾病经水**传播**，而非空气。
transparent§Transparent accounting is cheaper than the audit it prevents.§**透明的**账目比它所避免的审计更省钱。
travesty§To call the process a consultation was a travesty.§把这个过程称作协商是一种**歪曲**。
treacly§A treacly ending undoes ninety honest minutes.§**甜腻**的结尾毁掉了九十分钟的诚实。
treatise§A treatise nobody reads is still worth writing once.§没人读的**论著**仍然值得写一次。
tremulous§A tremulous first note steadied by the second bar.§**颤抖**的第一个音到第二小节就稳住了。
trenchant§Trenchant does not mean unkind, though it often reads that way.§**犀利**并不意味着刻薄，尽管常常读起来如此。
tribulation§Small tribulations make better reading than large ones.§小的**磨难**比大的更好读。
tribute§The town pays tribute to a battle it did not fight.§这个镇**纪念**着一场它并未参与的战役。
trigger§The trigger for the collapse was a rumour, not a fact.§**引发**崩溃的是一则谣言，而非事实。
triumph§A triumph in the archive is finding what you were not looking for.§档案工作的**胜利**，是找到你本来没在找的东西。
trivial§What is trivial to the writer is often crucial to the reader.§对作者**微不足道**的事，对读者往往至关重要。
trivialize§Statistics can trivialize a loss without meaning to.§统计数字可能无意中把一场损失**说得无关紧要**。
tropical§Tropical hardwood took two centuries to grow and a morning to cut.§**热带**硬木长了两个世纪，一个上午就被砍倒。
troubadour§A troubadour travelled with a repertoire and no manuscript.§**抒情诗人**带着一套曲目游走，却没有手稿。
trove§A trove of receipts told us more than the letters did.§**一批收据**告诉我们的比那些信件还多。
truce§An unofficial truce held for the length of the harvest.§一次非正式的**休战**维持了整个收获季。
